content:
There is one month to go until Apple's annual September launch event, and the latest Bloomberg report outlines eight new products expected to be unveiled.

Below are the new products Mark Gurman anticipates will appear at the September launch event

Mark Gurman wrote in his weekend 'Power On' newsletter:

According to Gurman's expectations, Apple will release eight new products next month:

  • iPhone 18 Pro
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • iPhone Ultra
  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • All-new Apple TV 4K
  • HomePod mini 2
  • HomePad／HomePod Touch

He added that the redesigned iPad mini will arrive this autumn, but falls under the October release lineup, and the MacBook Pro with M6 chip is also expected to launch in October.

The above list largely aligns with what we expected based on rumours and Apple's past practices.

Apple typically launches new iPhone and Apple Watch models simultaneously, and it makes sense to kick off its new smart home push at the same event.

September launch events consistently receive more attention than any other product launch, so if Apple wants its new smart home products to shine, this is the perfect timing. Moreover, smart home products are often seen as accessories to the iPhone, complementing the iPhone launch event.

Gurman did not mention new AirPods with cameras, a third-generation HomePod, or a security camera. The above products were all previously reported by Gurman and would also be suitable to appear at the September launch event.

Are you expecting any surprises from Apple's September launch event? Let us know in the comments.
